title: Too big for an int
description:
Read a number of years and print how many **seconds** that is (use 365 days per year).

An `int` can only hold about 2.1 billion, and 100 years is already more than 3 billion seconds. Use a 64-bit integer type so large inputs work.

For `1` print `31536000`. For `1000` print `31536000000`.
hints: If the variable you read into is 64-bit, the whole multiplication `years * 365 * 24 * 60 * 60` is done in 64-bit too.
